title: Trust Center: Evidence Accelerator notes
body:
Purpose:
This is a lightweight working playbook for the Trust Center evidence accelerator: a pragmatic set of notes for packaging customer questionnaire answers, audit-log extracts, RBAC maps, and SIEM-ready exports. Intended for security engineers, compliance owners, and solutions/CS reps who need to turn show-me evidence into a repeatable artifact quickly.

Scope and constraints:
- Focus: evidence bundles for enterprise RFPs and security questionnaires (SOC2, ISO/PCI pre-assessments, customers asking for audit-log exports).
- Not covering full FedRAMP package here (separate repo), but patterns are applicable.
- Assumes access to the audit-log export pipeline and to RBAC v2 config snapshots.

Quick wins (low friction):
1) Canonical evidence manifest (single line CSV + README):
   - file: evidence-manifest.csv (cols: artifact_id, artifact_type, source, time_range, redacted:yes/no, note)
   - README with narrative mapping artifact -> questionnaire question IDs.
2) SIEM-slice export (30-day window) for customers asking "show me what we log":
   - export fields: timestamp, principal_id, action, resource_id, request_id, status, ip, region, session_id, application, api_version
   - produce both newline-delimited JSON and CSV.
3) RBAC snapshot for review:
   - policy-roles.json (flattened list of roles, privileges, resource-scope)
   - map top 15 questions we see to the role samples (e.g., "Can a manager read audit logs?" -> role names + example Principal IDs)

Evidence packaging template (short):
- <customer>-evidence-<date>/
  - manifest.csv (required)
  - README.md (narrative + Q->artifact map)
  - siem-export.jsonl (30d / 90d depending on ask)
  - rbac-snapshot.json (RBAC v2 export at time-of-request)
  - screenshots/ (Console screenshots if needed, timestamped)
  - supporting-policies/ (links or PDF snippets: retention policy, access-review SOP)

Automation checklist (what we can ship quickly):
- [ ] Export job template for SIEM slices (paramaterized by start/end/timezone/tenant)
- [ ] Lambda/helper to redact PII fields based on customer sensitivity level and add redaction metadata to manifest
- [ ] Script to render RBAC snapshot into human-friendly mapping table (role -> actions -> example-principals)
- [ ] Small wrapper to commit packaged artifact into a signed S3 presigned URL plus checksum and version tag

Mapping evidence -> common questionnaire asks (examples):
- Q: "Do you maintain an immutable audit log?"
  Answer: Attach siem-export.jsonl (sample), manifest pointing to primary logging stream, retention policy PDF.
- Q: "Who can modify access controls?"
  Answer: Show rbac-snapshot.json and the change-approval SOP snippet; mark roles with modify_access:true in the snapshot.
- Q: "How quickly do you detect anomalous sign-ins?"
  Answer: Provide example alert runbook (link), and an event sample showing detection ID + timestamp.

Redaction policy (practical):
- Default: redact email, phone, full IP when sharing outside NDA. Keep truncated IP (first two octets) if customer asks for geo context.
- Replace principal_id with role:role-name for sample slices unless customer requests principal-level detail and has paperwork.
- Include a redaction-log.txt in the bundle explaining fields removed and reason.

SIEM export schema (recommended minimal fields):
- timestamp (ISO8601)
- tenant_id
- principal_id (redacted or pseudonymized)
- action (string: api.call or console.ui.click)
- resource_type
- resource_id
- request_id (trace id)
- outcome (success|failure|error-code)
- source_ip (redacted/partial)
- user_agent
- region
- event_latency_ms (if available)
- kv:free_form (JSON blob for extra fields)

Operational notes / gotchas (from recent exercises):
- Timezones: always normalize to UTC and add local timestamps only in README for business context.
- Large tenants: 30-day raw export can be >50GB; offer sampling or summary stats first.
- Query cost: avoid naive full-table scans in our export job; use partitioning by time + tenant.
- RBAC v2 exports sometimes include generated/system roles; mark these in the snapshot with system:true.

Example customer workflow (fast path):
1) Sales/CS gets questionnaire -> attach our intake form and ask for scope (time range, tenant id, level of identity detail).
2) Security owner triggers evidence-accelerator job (templated with params).
3) Delivery: provide signed artifact bundle + evidence-manifest.csv + short narrative (2–3 paragraphs) mapping bundle items to questionnaire IDs.
4) Customer follow-up: if they request more granular data, request SSO-signed DPA addendum or onsite review per process.

Items for product/engineering to consider (ask list):
- Small API to return RBAC v2 snapshots programmatically for a tenant + timestamp (versioned).
- Add an export flag in audit pipeline to produce an on-demand siem-slice with pseudonymization built-in.
- Improve documentation of "system roles" and standard role catalog for easier mapping in responses.

Open questions / decisions to make:
- What is the default retention window we show in public Trust Center snapshots? (recommended: 90d aggregated metrics, but raw exports on request)
- Who signs off on redaction decisions for customer-specific exports? (propose: security ops + customer success lead)
- SLA target for delivering a standard evidence bundle after intake: propose 5 business days for small customers, 10 for enterprise with >1TB exports.

Appendix: sample manifest.csv (example row)
artifact-001,siem-jsonl,primary-audit-stream,2024-11-01_2024-11-30,no,30d UTC slice; principal ids pseudonymized
artifact-002,rbac-snapshot,config-service,2024-11-07,yes,full RBAC v2 export; includes system:true flags

Next steps (owner: Ava):
- Finalize manifest template and commit to github: repo/redwood-evidence-helpers (PR target by 2024-12-01)
- Build small exporter for SIEM slices (scope: paramized, pseudonymize, manifest metadata)
- Run two pilot requests with Solutions Eng (Dec) to validate timings and edge cases

Notes to self / meeting fragments:
- "SRE mentioned sampling; need to add sampling knob to exporter" (Ravi)
- "Customer wants raw principal IDs in NDA; need checklist for legal to sign" (Sofia)
- TODO: add standard language for README about what constitutes PII in our logs

Contact: ava.martinez@redwood.com (internal)

-- end of working notes --
